title: Find where a PDLP run converged
heading: GLOP and PDLP Logs Carry the Same Facts in Other Words
cases: every progress row is read as iteration and three relative measures, and the header is not
the first row where all three measures are within the tolerance is the answer
a gap of -0.4 is far from converged, since its size is what counts
a row with a large dual residual is not converged, though the other two are small
a log whose rows never get within the tolerance gives None, not its last iteration
